dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ」
dialogues.en: "Phew."
dialogues.text: "Phew."

dialogues.jp:
フランクフルトを口に、たこ焼きを手に、中庭
のベンチに腰を下ろす。
dialogues.en:
I sat down on a bench in the courtyard with a hot dog in my
mouth and an octopus ball in my hand.
dialogues.text:
I sat down on a bench in the courtyard with a hot dog in my
mouth and an octopus ball in my hand.

dialogues.jp:
どこをどう間違っているのか、校舎を歩いてい
るだけで奇妙な眼差しにさらされていた。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure what was going on, but everybody was looking at
me with odd eyes as I was walking around in the school
buildings.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure what was going on, but everybody was looking at
me with odd eyes as I was walking around in the school
buildings.

dialogues.jp:
なにを評価されているのか知らないが、よほど
俺と杉並は期待されているらしい……。
dialogues.en:
I guess everybody's waiting for Suginami and me to do
something.......
dialogues.text:
I guess everybody's waiting for Suginami and me to do
something.......

dialogues.speaker: Junichi & A voice
dialogues.jp: 「人気者はまいるぜ」
dialogues.en: "I'm so popular."
dialogues.text: "I'm so popular."

dialogues.speaker: Junichi & A voice
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、ご無沙汰」
dialogues.en: "Hey, long time no see."
dialogues.text: "Hey, long time no see."

dialogues.jp:
ひょい、と俺のたこ焼きをひとつ口に放りこん
で、杉並がベンチの隣に座る。
dialogues.en: Suginami sat next me stealing my octopus ball.
dialogues.text: Suginami sat next me stealing my octopus ball.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「久しぶりだな」
dialogues.en: "It's been a while."
dialogues.text: "It's been a while."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「久しぶりってほどでもないだろうが」
dialogues.en: "It hasn't been that long."
dialogues.text: "It hasn't been that long."

dialogues.jp:
作り笑いを浮かべながら、なんとなく距離をと
る。
dialogues.en: I made myself smile and kept my distance from him.
dialogues.text: I made myself smile and kept my distance from him.

dialogues.jp:
いかん、疲れを増幅させるやつに出会ってしまっ
た……。
dialogues.en:
It's too bad that he found me. He makes me even more
tired......
dialogues.text:
It's too bad that he found me. He makes me even more
tired......

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「警戒するなよ。パーティーにはまだ早い」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so cautious. It's still too early to party."
dialogues.text: "Don't be so cautious. It's still too early to party."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうした。感動的な卒業を迎えて、つい感傷
　的になってるのか」
dialogues.en:
"What happened? Are you feeling down from the sentimental
graduation ceremony?"
dialogues.text:
"What happened? Are you feeling down from the sentimental
graduation ceremony?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっ、柄じゃない」
dialogues.en: "I'm not that type."
dialogues.text: "I'm not that type."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が手を広げてニヘヘと笑う。
dialogues.en: Suginami opened his arms and smiled.
dialogues.text: Suginami opened his arms and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、まいったまいった。講師と風紀委員
　と中央委員会に｛にら／睨｝まれててな」
dialogues.en:
"It was pretty tough. The teachers, the school committee and
the central committee are watching me."
dialogues.text:
"It was pretty tough. The teachers, the school committee and
the central committee are watching me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「発信機を他の人間にくっ付けてまいてきた。
　これで５分は稼げるはずだ」
dialogues.en:
"I put the transmitter on someone else. It should give me at
least five minutes."
dialogues.text:
"I put the transmitter on someone else. It should give me at
least five minutes."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ……総力戦だな」
dialogues.en: "Wow...... that's a tough crowd."
dialogues.text: "Wow...... that's a tough crowd."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今年は、実力行使で阻止するらしい。ふっ
　……なりふりかまっていられないらしいな」
dialogues.en:
"I guess they're trying to stop me with force this year.
They're pretty desperate."
dialogues.text:
"I guess they're trying to stop me with force this year.
They're pretty desperate."

dialogues.jp:
風紀委員と中央委員会といえば、風見学園でも
最高のエリート集団だ。
dialogues.en:
Students who are involved in the school committee and the
central committee are all elites of the Kazami Academy.
dialogues.text:
Students who are involved in the school committee and the
central committee are all elites of the Kazami Academy.

dialogues.jp: 発信機も盗聴機もお手の物だろうが……。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure a transmitter or a wiretap would be no problem for
them......
dialogues.text:
I'm sure a transmitter or a wiretap would be no problem for
them......

dialogues.jp:
「あいつらに睨まれて、それでも逃げ切れるお
　前も恐ろしいがな」
dialogues.en: "I'm more impressed by you being able to flee from them."
dialogues.text: "I'm more impressed by you being able to flee from them."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹だけでもお前が担当してくれれば、相
　当楽なんだがな」
dialogues.en:
"It would make my life so much easier if you could take care
of your sister for me."
dialogues.text:
"It would make my life so much easier if you could take care
of your sister for me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「勘弁してくれ」
dialogues.en: "Don't even go there."
dialogues.text: "Don't even go there."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「行動パターンが読まれてるからなぁ。さっき
　まで朝倉妹にだけ追われてたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"She knows my behavioral pattern. She's the hardest one to
flee from."
dialogues.text:
"She knows my behavioral pattern. She's the hardest one to
flee from."

dialogues.jp:
ごそごそ、と缶ジュースを取り出して、１本を
俺に投げてよこす。
dialogues.en: He took out some sodas from his bag, and threw one at me.
dialogues.text: He took out some sodas from his bag, and threw one at me.

dialogues.jp: 「お、サンキュって炭酸かい」
dialogues.en: "Thanks. But don't throw soda, man."
dialogues.text: "Thanks. But don't throw soda, man."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、なんか雰囲気違うぞ」
dialogues.en: "You look different."
dialogues.text: "You look different."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ジュースを口につけたまま、杉並が目を細めて
前を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Suginami narrowed his eyes and looked as he sipped his soda.
dialogues.text: Suginami narrowed his eyes and looked as he sipped his soda.

dialogues.jp: 「……またその話か。耳たこだ」
dialogues.en: "That again? I'm so sick and tired of it."
dialogues.text: "That again? I'm so sick and tired of it."

dialogues.jp: プルタブを開けて、炭酸みたいに息をつく。
dialogues.en: I pulled the can open and sighed.
dialogues.text: I pulled the can open and sighed.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「みんな心配してるのさ」
dialogues.en: "Everybody's worried about you."
dialogues.text: "Everybody's worried about you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: かなり素で反応してしまう。
dialogues.en: I didn't know what to say.
dialogues.text: I didn't know what to say.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだかんだで、朝倉兄妹がおかしいと、他
　の連中も――俺もなんか調子でなくてなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"It doesn't feel right if you guys are acting weird.
Everybody feels that, and it affects me too."
dialogues.text:
"It doesn't feel right if you guys are acting weird.
Everybody feels that, and it affects me too."

dialogues.jp: 吹き抜けの青空を見上げた。
dialogues.en: I looked up at the sky.
dialogues.text: I looked up at the sky.

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、俺と音夢って兄妹だよな」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu and I are brother and sister, right?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu and I are brother and sister, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 今度は杉並がおかしな声を上げる。
dialogues.en: It was his turn to question.
dialogues.text: It was his turn to question.

dialogues.jp: 「いやさ、音夢は……可愛いと思う」
dialogues.en: "You know...... I think Nemu's cute."
dialogues.text: "You know...... I think Nemu's cute."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: ――ガン！
dialogues.en: Crash!
dialogues.text: Crash!

dialogues.jp: ん？
dialogues.en: What?
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.jp:
近くのゴミ箱が揺れている。誰かがぶつかって
いったのか？
dialogues.en: I saw the garbage can shaking. Did someone run into it?
dialogues.text: I saw the garbage can shaking. Did someone run into it?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前、頭平気か？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん、ちとキテるかも知れない」
dialogues.en: "I'm not sure, but I might be going crazy."
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure, but I might be going crazy."

dialogues.jp: ニヘヘ、と苦笑がもれる。
dialogues.en: I grinned.
dialogues.text: I grinned.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「相当な状態だと思うぞ」
dialogues.en: "I think this could be a complicated situation."
dialogues.text: "I think this could be a complicated situation."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ははっ、お前に言われるとは重症だな」
dialogues.en: "It must be pretty bad if you say so."
dialogues.text: "It must be pretty bad if you say so."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ？　ついに朝倉妹と、血の繋がりがな
　いことでも実感したのか？」
dialogues.en:
"So, you finally understand that your sister's adopted and
not related to you by blood?"
dialogues.text:
"So, you finally understand that your sister's adopted and
not related to you by blood?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Wow!?"
dialogues.text: "Wow!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ぐ、げほっ……なんで知ってんだよ！？」
dialogues.en: "How did you know?"
dialogues.text: "How did you know?"

dialogues.jp: 吹きだしたコーラを拭って｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I spilled soda so I had to wipe it.
dialogues.text: I spilled soda so I had to wipe it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「や〜っぱりそうなのか」
dialogues.en: "So I was right......"
dialogues.text: "So I was right......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Shit!!"
dialogues.text: "Shit!!"

dialogues.jp: 語るに落ちた。
dialogues.en: It was a trap.
dialogues.text: It was a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わははははははははは！　このスーパー公式
　裏新聞部の俺に隠し事が出来ると思ったか！」
dialogues.en:
"Hahahahaha! You can't hide anything from our super official
unofficial newspaper club!"
dialogues.text:
"Hahahahaha! You can't hide anything from our super official
unofficial newspaper club!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「公式で裏？」
dialogues.en: "You're officially unofficial?"
dialogues.text: "You're officially unofficial?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「調子出てきたみたいじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "There you go."
dialogues.text: "There you go."

dialogues.jp: ニヤリ、と杉並が最高の笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: Suginami gave me a great smile.
dialogues.text: Suginami gave me a great smile.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだそりゃ！？」
dialogues.en: "What's that for?"
dialogues.text: "What's that for?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「悩むことじゃないだろうが。正直になれって。
　面白いことと好きなことやるのが俺達だ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm just telling you to be honest. It's nothing to be
worried about. We always do what we want and what's fun."
dialogues.text:
"I'm just telling you to be honest. It's nothing to be
worried about. We always do what we want and what's fun."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ただの迷惑野郎じゃねぇかそれは……」
dialogues.en: "That sounds like an immature troublemaker......"
dialogues.text: "That sounds like an immature troublemaker......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前は朝倉妹が好きだから悩んでるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You're troubled because you love your sister."
dialogues.text: "You're troubled because you love your sister."

dialogues.jp: ガコン――。
dialogues.en: Crash!
dialogues.text: Crash!

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: またゴミ箱が揺れる。
dialogues.en: I saw the garbage can shake again.
dialogues.text: I saw the garbage can shake again.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだあれは？」
dialogues.en: "What's that?"
dialogues.text: "What's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、あれな。俺が音が鳴ると動くように改
　造してるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, that? I'm converting that garbage can so that it moves
when it hears noises."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, that? I'm converting that garbage can so that it moves
when it hears noises."

dialogues.jp:
飲み干した缶を、コン、と杉並がゴミ箱に放り
投げる。
dialogues.en: Suginami threw the empty soda can at the garbage can.
dialogues.text: Suginami threw the empty soda can at the garbage can.

dialogues.jp: ――コン
dialogues.en: Conk!
dialogues.text: Conk!

dialogues.jp: ガコン――コンコン
dialogues.en: Crash ----conk, conk.
dialogues.text: Crash ----conk, conk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「凄いだろう？　ハリウッドも香港のワイヤー
　アクションもびっくり」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that great? Hollywood, here I come."
dialogues.text: "Isn't that great? Hollywood, here I come."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あんなのに技術を集結してもなぁ……誰か
　が後ろにいて頭ぶつけてるだけなんじゃな
　いか？」
dialogues.en:
"You're wasting your time...... Isn't there someone behind
the garbage can hitting their head on it?"
dialogues.text:
"You're wasting your time...... Isn't there someone behind
the garbage can hitting their head on it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それも可だ」
dialogues.en: "That would be another possibility."
dialogues.text: "That would be another possibility."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くだらねぇ……用件なしか？」
dialogues.en: "That's stupid. So what do you want from me?"
dialogues.text: "That's stupid. So what do you want from me?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ。たまたま見かけたから声をかけただけ
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"I just came to talk to you because I happened to see you
sitting here."
dialogues.text:
"I just came to talk to you because I happened to see you
sitting here."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あっそ」
dialogues.en: "Fine."
dialogues.text: "Fine."

dialogues.jp: 立ちあがって、ポケットに手をつっこむ。
dialogues.en: I stood up and put my hands in my pockets.
dialogues.text: I stood up and put my hands in my pockets.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どこ行くんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where are you going?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you going?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あん？　……帰る」
dialogues.en: "Huh? I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "Huh? I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、おい、まだ始まったばかりだぞ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, it just started!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, it just started!"

dialogues.jp: 背中にかかる声に手を振り返す。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand at him.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand at him.

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃんだよ」
dialogues.en: "But it's a pain."
dialogues.text: "But it's a pain."

dialogues.jp: かなり本気で呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled seriously.
dialogues.text: I mumbled seriously.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩や暦先生にも会ってないが、どうにも今
日は駄目だ……。
dialogues.en:
I haven't seen Moe-sempai or Koyomi-sensei, but I can't take
it anymore.
dialogues.text:
I haven't seen Moe-sempai or Koyomi-sensei, but I can't take
it anymore.

dialogues.jp:
誰に会っても、音夢との仲を聞かれることだろ
う。
dialogues.en: I'm sure they'll ask me about Nemu.
dialogues.text: I'm sure they'll ask me about Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おい、ちょっと待てよ」
dialogues.en: "Wait. Hold on."
dialogues.text: "Wait. Hold on."

dialogues.jp: 振り向く。
dialogues.en: I turned around.
dialogues.text: I turned around.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹に捕まったら、なにか言っておこう
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to say something to your sister?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to say something to your sister?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな」
dialogues.en: "......I guess."
dialogues.text: "......I guess."

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ考えて。
dialogues.en: I thought about it.
dialogues.text: I thought about it.

dialogues.jp: 正直になろうと思った。
dialogues.en: I decided to be honest.
dialogues.text: I decided to be honest.

dialogues.jp: 「無理するなよ――俺はかったりぃんだ」
dialogues.en: "Take it easy. I'm way too tired."
dialogues.text: "Take it easy. I'm way too tired."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「前と後ろどっち？」
dialogues.en: "Which one?"
dialogues.text: "Which one?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「両方だ。頼むぜ」
dialogues.en: "Both of them. Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Both of them. Thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「了解。万が一、俺が捕まったらだがな」
dialogues.en: "I got it. But only if I get caught."
dialogues.text: "I got it. But only if I get caught."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「捕まれバカ」
dialogues.en: "You should get caught, idiot."
dialogues.text: "You should get caught, idiot."

dialogues.jp: 憎まれ口を叩いて、また歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I made it sound bad on purpose and turned around.
dialogues.text: I made it sound bad on purpose and turned around.

dialogues.jp: ……ちくしょう。
dialogues.en: ...Shit.
dialogues.text: ...Shit.

dialogues.jp: 足取りが軽い。
dialogues.en: I feel better.
dialogues.text: I feel better.

dialogues.jp:
「帰ろうと思ったのに、なんとなく元気が出て
　きちまったじゃねぇか」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking about going home, but I feel much better
now."
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking about going home, but I feel much better
now."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まったく。迷惑かけてくれる兄妹だなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh man. You two are a bunch of trouble."
dialogues.text: "Oh man. You two are a bunch of trouble."

dialogues.jp: ベンチに深く座って、ゴミ箱に語りかける。
dialogues.en: He sat on the bench and talked to the garbage can.
dialogues.text: He sat on the bench and talked to the garbage can.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うぅぅ。迷惑かけてるのは杉並くんですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Mm...... You're much more troublesome, Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Mm...... You're much more troublesome, Suginami."

dialogues.jp: ゴミ箱の影から朝倉妹が立ちあがった。
dialogues.en: Nemu came out of the shadow of the garbage can.
dialogues.text: Nemu came out of the shadow of the garbage can.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ひどいですよ……なんです、音がすると動く
　ゴミ箱って」
dialogues.en: "What was that moving garbage can about?"
dialogues.text: "What was that moving garbage can about?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誤魔化さんといけなかっただろうが」
dialogues.en: "I had to make an excuse, you know?"
dialogues.text: "I had to make an excuse, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「後ろから見てる人に、変な人だって指差され
　ましたよ私」
dialogues.en: "Somebody pointed and called me a weirdo from behind."
dialogues.text: "Somebody pointed and called me a weirdo from behind."

dialogues.jp:
しょんぼり、と肩を落として朝倉妹が目の前に
立ちふさがる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stood in front of me dropping her shoulders, looking
sad.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stood in front of me dropping her shoulders, looking
sad.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「１００パーセント自業自得だ」
dialogues.en: "You asked for it."
dialogues.text: "You asked for it."

dialogues.jp:
胸ポケットを漁って、卒業式の最後に在校生に
もらった造花をとりだした。
dialogues.en:
Suginami looked into his chest pocket on his uniform and
took out the imitation flower he got at the end of the
graduation ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Suginami looked into his chest pocket on his uniform and
took out the imitation flower he got at the end of the
graduation ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「盗聴機はこれだな？」
dialogues.en: "So this's the bug."
dialogues.text: "So this's the bug."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……それ、わざと捨てなかったんですね」
dialogues.en: "You knew it all along, didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "You knew it all along, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp:
耳から小型のイヤホンをはずして、朝倉妹も表
情を柔らかくする。
dialogues.en:
Nemu took out the small earphone from her ear and softened
her attitude.
dialogues.text:
Nemu took out the small earphone from her ear and softened
her attitude.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「電波の有効半径は１０メートルくらいだから、
　朝倉兄妹の秘密はばれてないな」
dialogues.en:
"The effective radius of the radio waves is about 10 meters,
so your secret shouldn't have been heard by anyone."
dialogues.text:
"The effective radius of the radio waves is about 10 meters,
so your secret shouldn't have been heard by anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うぁ、そこまで調べてあったの！？」
dialogues.en: "You knew that too?"
dialogues.text: "You knew that too?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「黒服の集団に比べたら、こんなものは｛じぎ／児戯｝だ
　な」
dialogues.en: "This is a toy compared to the men in black."
dialogues.text: "This is a toy compared to the men in black."

dialogues.jp: 盗聴機もゴミ箱に放りこむ。
dialogues.en: He threw the wiretap into the garbage can.
dialogues.text: He threw the wiretap into the garbage can.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつも何と戦ってるんですか……」
dialogues.en: "Who are you running away from?"
dialogues.text: "Who are you running away from?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「みんな信じないだろうが、世界の平和は俺が
　守っているんだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I know nobody believes this, but I'm the one who's keeping
peace in this world."
dialogues.text:
"I know nobody believes this, but I'm the one who's keeping
peace in this world."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……杉並くんに守られてるくらいなら、人類
　は滅んじゃってもいいかも」
dialogues.en: "We may be as good as dead, if that's a truth."
dialogues.text: "We may be as good as dead, if that's a truth."

dialogues.jp: くすくす、と朝倉妹が微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「その笑顔を見せてやれよ。あいつにも」
dialogues.en: "You should give that smile to him."
dialogues.text: "You should give that smile to him."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……ごめんね」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「謝るのは俺にじゃないっての」
dialogues.en: "Don't apologize to me."
dialogues.text: "Don't apologize to me."

dialogues.jp: 両手を組んで、軽く頷く。
dialogues.en: He folded his arm and nods lightly.
dialogues.text: He folded his arm and nods lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……じゃあ、ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Well...... then, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Well...... then, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なぁに、礼には及ばないさ。ちょっと、今日
　起こる出来事に目をつぶってくれればな」
dialogues.en: "Don't mention it. You just need to let me go."
dialogues.text: "Don't mention it. You just need to let me go."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それとこれとは話が別だから」
dialogues.en: "That's another story."
dialogues.text: "That's another story."

dialogues.jp: 涙目を拭って、朝倉妹の腕が高速に揺れる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu moved her arms really fast wiping her tears from her
eyes.
dialogues.text:
Nemu moved her arms really fast wiping her tears from her
eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: ガション、と上げようとした腕がひっかかる。
dialogues.en:
He noticed his arm was caught by something as he tried to
raise his arm.
dialogues.text:
He noticed his arm was caught by something as he tried to
raise his arm.

dialogues.jp: 見ると、ベンチと手首が手錠で繋がれていた。
dialogues.en: He found his arm connected to the bench by handcuffs.
dialogues.text: He found his arm connected to the bench by handcuffs.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「とっつあん！？」
dialogues.en: "No way!!"
dialogues.text: "No way!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それでは、ごきげんよう杉並くん。雰囲気だ
　けでもパーティー楽しんでね」
dialogues.en: "Well then. Farewell Suginami. Enjoy the party."
dialogues.text: "Well then. Farewell Suginami. Enjoy the party."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お、おぃ！　コレこのままにしてどこに行く
　んだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey! Where are you going leaving me here??"
dialogues.text: "Hey! Where are you going leaving me here??"

dialogues.jp: 唇に指を当てて朝倉妹が考える。
dialogues.en: Nemu put her finger on her lip and thought about it.
dialogues.text: Nemu put her finger on her lip and thought about it.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ナイショ♪」
dialogues.en: "It's a secret."
dialogues.text: "It's a secret."

dialogues.jp:
スカートを翻して、校舎には戻らず朝倉妹はそ
のまま下駄箱に向かって走り去った。
dialogues.en:
Nemu flared her skirt and ran to the entrance of the school,
not returning to the main building.
dialogues.text:
Nemu flared her skirt and ran to the entrance of the school,
not returning to the main building.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まいったな……いつもの通りに戻りすぎだっ
　ての」
dialogues.en: "Crap...... She went back to her old self way too fast."
dialogues.text: "Crap...... She went back to her old self way too fast."

dialogues.jp: 頭をかいて、しかし笑みを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: He scratched his head but smiled.
dialogues.text: He scratched his head but smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「さて、主賓がふたり減ってしまったが……
　まぁ、眞子でもからかって遊ぶか」
dialogues.en: "We're two VIP down now... But maybe I can tease Mako."
dialogues.text: "We're two VIP down now... But maybe I can tease Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: ふと、視線に気づいた。
dialogues.en: He felt something.
dialogues.text: He felt something.

dialogues.jp:
見渡すと、教員棟の通路に小さな人影が立って、
朝倉妹が去った方向を見つめている。
dialogues.en:
He looked around and found a person standing in a hallway
close by, looking at where Nemu has gone to.
dialogues.text:
He looked around and found a person standing in a hallway
close by, looking at where Nemu has gone to.

dialogues.jp: 微かな敵意をもって。
dialogues.en: He felt slight hostility.
dialogues.text: He felt slight hostility.

dialogues.jp: 束ねた髪が風になびいている。
dialogues.en: Her long hair was streaming in the wind.
dialogues.text: Her long hair was streaming in the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……未知の転入生？」
dialogues.en: "Is that the new girl?"
dialogues.text: "Is that the new girl?"

dialogues.jp:
しかし、視線を軽く動かした後、その姿は風に
流されたように消えていた。
dialogues.en:
But she disappeared in a moment, as if she was blown away by
the wind.
dialogues.text:
But she disappeared in a moment, as if she was blown away by
the wind.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……まさに未知だな」
dialogues.en: "She sure is strange."
dialogues.text: "She sure is strange."

dialogues.jp:
ニヤリと笑い、そのまま髪の中からヘアピンを
取り出して手錠の鍵穴に重ねた。
dialogues.en:
He grinned and took out a bobby pin out of his hair and
placed it into the keyhole of the handcuff.
dialogues.text:
He grinned and took out a bobby pin out of his hair and
placed it into the keyhole of the handcuff.

dialogues.jp: ――カチリ
dialogues.en: Click...
dialogues.text: Click...

dialogues.jp: ◆義妹発覚◆
dialogues.en: ◆The secret discovered◆
dialogues.text: ◆The secret discovered◆

dialogues.jp:
校舎を歩いているだけで奇妙な眼差しにさらさ
る。まったく、よほど俺と杉並は期待されてい
るらしい……。
dialogues.en:
Everybody was looking at me oddly. They must be thinking
that Suginami and I'll do something to stir up the party.
dialogues.text:
Everybody was looking at me oddly. They must be thinking
that Suginami and I'll do something to stir up the party.

dialogues.jp:
その杉並が、様子のおかしい俺と音夢を見て、
俺を励ましに来た。しかも音夢が義妹なことに
感づいていたとは。
dialogues.en:
Suginami came to talk to me since Nemu and I are acting
weird. He knew that Nemu was my step sister.
dialogues.text:
Suginami came to talk to me since Nemu and I are acting
weird. He knew that Nemu was my step sister.

dialogues.jp:
素直になれ……か。まったく、おせっかいな奴
だ。
dialogues.en: He told me to be honest. Such a nosy guy.
dialogues.text: He told me to be honest. Such a nosy guy.

dialogues.jp: でも、正直になろうと思った。
dialogues.en: But I decided to be honest about it.
dialogues.text: But I decided to be honest about it.
